- **`toTitle`:** uses `startCase` from `es-toolkit/compat`. The main `es-toolkit` `startCase` lowercases the rest of each word, so `"ABC"` would become `"Abc"` where lodash gives `"ABC"`. The input range includes consecutive capitals, so the compat version is needed.
- **`toLookup`:** uses `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat`. The main package has no `fromPairs`.
- **Size:** `npm run size -- out/module.ts` reports 2009 bytes (min+gzip) and 85 bytes of own code. Importing all three from `es-toolkit/compat` came to 3669 bytes, so I kept `merge` on the main entry.

The lodash imports are gone, and there are no hand-written replacements or adapters. The exported signatures and the `Row` and `Config` types are unchanged. The original `src/module.ts` doesn't type-check in this environment because `lodash` isn't installed.
